info.title: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus
info.description:
Authentication: static Authtoken (technician API key sent in the `authtoken` header).

ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus on-premise ITSM REST API (V3) for managing requests (tickets), problems, changes, and assets/configuration items.

Source: https://help.servicedeskplus.com/api/rest-api.html

servers.description: ServiceDesk Plus on-premise server. The real API base path (/api/v3) is configured separately via the instance's base_path setting -- see the product README.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of requests, optionally filtered via `input_data`.
Retrieves a single request by ID.
Returns a paginated list of problems, optionally filtered via `input_data`.
Retrieves a single problem by ID.
Returns a paginated list of changes, optionally filtered via `input_data`.
Retrieves a single change by ID.
Returns a paginated list of assets, optionally filtered via `input_data`.
Retrieves a single asset by ID.
Returns the notes added to a request.

post.description: Adds a note to a request.

get.description: Retrieves the resolution recorded on a request.

put.description: Adds or updates the resolution recorded on a request.

get.description: Returns technicians, for populating assignment lookups on requests/problems/changes.
Returns requesters, for populating the requester lookup on a request.

subject.description: Short summary of the request, max 250 characters.

udf_fields.description: Custom (user-defined) fields, keyed by field name.
Custom (user-defined) fields, keyed by field name.

name.description: Current stage of the change process

udf_fields.description: Custom (user-defined) fields, keyed by field name.

Asset.description: An asset or configuration item (CI). ServiceDesk Plus models CIs as assets scoped to a CI-type product, so this same resource covers both hardware/software assets and non-workstation CIs.

name.description: Product type -- determines whether this is treated as an asset or a CI

udf_fields.description: Custom (user-defined) fields, keyed by field name.

Note.description: A note added to a request.

Resolution.description: The resolution recorded on a request.

AuthToken.name: authtoken
AuthToken.description: Static technician API key. Generate one from a technician's User Profile > Generate Authtoken (select Never Expires), or Admin > Developer Space > API for an integration-scoped key.
